scripts.build:plugin:jira: swift build -c release --package-path apps/plugin-jira && mkdir -p ./dist && cp ./apps/plugin-jira/.build/release/toby-plugin-jira ./dist/toby-plugin-jira
scripts.build:plugin:websearch: swift build -c release --package-path apps/plugin-websearch && mkdir -p ./dist && cp ./apps/plugin-websearch/.build/release/toby-plugin-websearch ./dist/toby-plugin-websearch
scripts.build:plugin:applecalendar: swift build -c release --package-path apps/plugin-applecalendar && mkdir -p ./dist && cp ./apps/plugin-applecalendar/.build/release/toby-plugin-applecalendar ./dist/toby-plugin-applecalendar
scripts.build:plugin:macos: bash ./scripts/build-bundled-shortcuts.sh && swift build -c release --package-path apps/plugin-macos && mkdir -p ./dist && cp ./apps/plugin-macos/.build/release/toby-plugin-macos ./dist/toby-plugin-macos && cp -R ./apps/plugin-macos/.build/release/TobyPluginMacOS_TobyPluginMacOSLib.bundle ./dist/
scripts.build:plugins: bun run build:plugin:sample && bun run build:plugin:azuread && bun run build:plugin:gmail && bun run build:plugin:todoist && bun run build:plugin:slack && bun run build:plugin:jira && bun run build:plugin:websearch && bun run build:plugin:applecalendar && bun run build:plugin:macos && bun run build:plugin:whisper
scripts.build:executable: bun run build:audio-helper && bun run build:plugins && mkdir -p ./dist && (cd apps/cli && bun build ./src/cli.ts --compile --outfile ../../dist/toby) && cp ./apps/audio-helper/.build/release/toby-audio-helper ./dist/toby-listener
scripts.restart:server: bun run --cwd apps/cli dev daemon restart
